---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Summary

A short description of what you want and why.

## Recorder backend

Which backend(s) does this apply to? `sqlite` / `mariadb` / `postgres` / all.

## Describe the feature

What should the app do? How would it work from the user's perspective?

## Why is this useful?

What problem does it solve, or what does it let you do that you can't today?

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried working around this with an existing feature (single-point
vs. bulk correction, a different quality code, exporting the CSV)? What
didn't work?

## Additional context

Screenshots, example sensor data, links to relevant Home Assistant docs.
